resources.string: This app emulates a Credit Card
The app needs to be called by the Select the PPSE (2PAY.SYS.DDF01) AID. The emulated Credit Card is of type Visa Card and has the AID A0000000031010
This application emulates an NFC tag ("Writer") and reads the received data ("Reader") on another device.

There are 3 icons to click on:
1 home = this page
2 send data with HCE to another device
3 read data = receives the data from the HCE emulated NFC tag
This example expects an emulated NFC tag using the AID F22334455667.\n\nWhen a tag is discovered the data from files 01 and 02 will be read.
